Northwind's invoices exported with the wrong tax rate for their Dutch entity, and their finance team only caught it after some had already been sent to clients [[M2#16]]. Diego traced it to the rounding change from August, which only affects accounts with multiple tax jurisdictions — essentially just Northwind [[M2#17]]. Forty-one invoices over two weeks were affected; the calculation fix was quick, but regenerating the already-sent PDFs was the painful part [[M2#19]].

Handling: Diego fixed the calculation that day and sent Northwind the list of affected invoice numbers so they could issue corrections, while Marco called their CFO himself [[M2#20]][[M2#21]]. Marco told Diego not to promise any credit in the note, deciding after the call [[M2#23]].

Resolution (a week later): corrected invoices went out, Northwind's finance team confirmed the numbers, and the CFO replied — the issue was closed [[M3#9]]. Marco gave them one month free as compensation, and Ana applied the credit that day [[M3#10]][[M3#11]].
